question: Where can I get a list of solar PV plants in operation in Germany, with location, capacity (MW), operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: The Bundesnetzagentur’s Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) lists registered PV units with status, commissioning date, gross and net capacity in kW and operator identifiers. Filtering for solar energy and operating status yields 6,534,010 units on 2026-11-27, including 20,213 ground-mounted units. Use the extended overview or the daily XML export. Coordinates were found for 262,196 operating units over 30 kW net in the sample. Natural-person operator names are withheld. A park can span several registered units.
main_caveats: In the export checked, precise coordinates were unavailable for operating PV units of up to 30 kW net. About 96% of registered operating PV units fell in this range.
Operator names are published only for organisations; natural persons appear as 'natürliche Person (ABR…)' – 86% of all operating units and about one in five ground-mounted units in the pages sampled.

The counting unit is the MaStR 'Einheit': one park can be several units (phases, operators); group with LokationMastrNr. Without filters the list also holds 1.56 million balcony units and planned or shut-down units.
Capacity is in kW on two bases: Bruttoleistung = module peak (DC, kWp), Nettonennleistung = lower of module and inverter rating. Divide by 1,000 for MW and do not mix with GEM's MWac.
Operators have one month to register after commissioning, so the latest month is incomplete; the web CSV export stops at 25,000 rows.
answer.confidence_reason: All four attributes were checked in MaStR with live counts and samples, and the publication limits are cited from § 15 MaStRV; regional and non-official sources were sampled, not exhausted.

attributes.note: The export checked reported WGS84 points for 262,196 operating units above 30 kW net. The smaller units are located by postcode and municipality.
attributes.gap_note: § 15(1) Nr. 1a MaStRV withholds street, parcel and coordinates of units ≤30 kW; checked in the MaStR overview, the XML export, the TSO EEG files and the regulation.

attributes.note: Per unit in kW: Bruttoleistung (module kWp, DC) and Nettonennleistung (lower of module and inverter rating); divide by 1,000 for MW.
Operator name for organisations; natural persons shown as 'natürliche Person (ABR…)' (19.5% of a sampled page of parks, 86% of all units).
attributes.gap_note: § 15(1) Nr. 2 MaStRV withholds data of natural-person operators; confirmed in MaStR JSON (AnlagenbetreiberPersonenArt 518) and the Marktakteure export; TSO files carry no operator.

attributes.note: Inbetriebnahmedatum (first commissioning) present for every unit 'In Betrieb' in all samples checked.

unit.value: kW for both capacity fields: Bruttoleistung = summed module rating (kWp, DC side); Nettonennleistung = net nominal rating – in all 1,627 export records checked it equals the lower of Bruttoleistung and the assigned inverter power (ZugeordneteWirkleistungWechselrichter). Divide by 1,000 for MW.
unit.quote: Bruttoleistung der gesamten Solaranlage: In einigen Fällen liegt nur eine Herstellerangabe zur Leistung pro Modul vor. In diesem Fall muss die Leistung der einzelnen Module zusammenaddiert werden. Achten Sie hierbei darauf, die Leistung in kWp umzurechnen.

inclusion_rule.value: Every grid-connected generating unit, with no size threshold and including self-consumption units, must be registered by its operator; modules of one operator commissioned together at the same site form one 'Einheit' (§ 5(1) MaStRV).
inclusion_rule.quote: Die Vollständigkeit der Daten ist ein unverzichtbares Fundament dieser Transparenz. Sie ergibt sich daraus, dass das MaStR die Daten aller Anlagen enthält und dass für die Registrierung keine Abschneide-Grenze gilt.

reference_date.value: Data as of the previous day (page showed 'Datenstand: 27.11.2026 00:00 Uhr' on 2026-11-27).
reference_date.quote: Diese „Erweiterte Einheitenübersicht“ enthält alle Daten, die bis zum Vortag im MaStR neu eingetragen oder geändert wurden.

update_frequency.value: Daily (previous-day state); the 'Aktuelle Einheitenübersicht' is real-time but has fewer columns and no coordinates column.
update_frequency.quote: Diese „Erweiterte Einheitenübersicht“ enthält alle Daten, die bis zum Vortag im MaStR neu eingetragen oder geändert wurden.

exclusions.value: Not in the register: off-grid units and defence installations. Published without location detail (street, house number, Flurstück, coordinates): units of at most 30 kW. Operator data of natural persons are masked ('natürliche Person (ABR…)'); critical-infrastructure units can be withheld on request.
exclusions.quote: Nur Anlagen, die weder unmittelbar noch mittelbar ans Netz angeschlossen sind, und Anlagen, die der Landesverteidigung dienen, müssen nicht registriert werden.

Location ID (SEL…) shared by units at the same generation site; use it to group the phases of one park.
Free display name chosen by the operator / optional park name.

Date of first commissioning of the unit, as /Date(epoch-ms)/ (UTC midnight).
Commissioning date at the current site for relocated units (usually null).
Gross capacity in kW = summed module rating (kWp, DC).
Net nominal capacity in kW = lower of module and inverter rating in the records checked; the field the 30 kW publication threshold follows.
852 Freiflächensolaranlage, 853 Gebäudesolaranlage, 2484 Sonstige Solaranlage, 2961 Steckerfertige Solaranlage (Balkonkraftwerk).
Volleinspeisung vs Teileinspeisung (einschließlich Eigenverbrauch) – the self-consumption marker.
WGS84 point of the unit; null for units with Nettonennleistung ≤ 30 kW.

key_fields.field: Plz / Ort / Gemeinde / Gemeindeschluessel / Landkreis / Bundesland
key_fields.meaning: Administrative location, published for every unit.
Operator name (organisations only), operator ID (ABR…), 517 organisation / 518 natural person (name masked).
Grid connection voltage level and connecting DSO/TSO.
Grid-operator check: 2954 Geprüft, 2955 In Prüfung, 3075 Nicht vorgesehen.

steps: Filter syntax (Kendo): filter=Energieträger~eq~'2495' (Solare Strahlungsenergie)~and~Betriebs-Status~eq~'35' (In Betrieb); add ~and~Art der Solaranlage~eq~'852' for ground-mounted parks or ~and~Nettonennleistung der Einheit~gt~'30' for the subset with coordinates. Filter names and code lists come from GetFilterColumnsErweiterteOeffentlicheEinheitStromerzeugung.
Paginate with page=1,2,… and pageSize up to 1000 (tested); 'Total' gives the row count of the filter.
Convert InbetriebnahmeDatum '/Date(ms)/' to a date (epoch milliseconds, UTC): /Date(1644451200000)/ = 2022-02-10.
Divide Bruttoleistung/Nettonennleistung by 1,000 for MW and keep both columns (DC vs AC).
Group units into plants with LokationMastrNr when a park was registered in several phases.
For a manual extract, the same filters can be set on the 'Erweiterte Einheitenübersicht' page and exported with 'Tabelle exportieren / CSV-Export' (25,000 rows per export).

An authenticated SOAP Webdienst (described at https://www.marktstammdatenregister.de/MaStRHilfe/subpages/webdienst.html) serves the same register; it needs a registered MaStR account with a Webdienst-Key and is limited to 100,000 calls per day.
reading_traps: Counting unit is the MaStR 'Einheit', not the plant: parks built in phases appear as several SEE units; in a 1,000-row page of Freiflächen units 217 shared their LokationMastrNr with another unit on the page.

Capacities are kW, not MW. Bruttoleistung (module kWp) exceeded Nettonennleistung in 722 of 1,000 sampled units >30 kW; in the 1,628-unit export file Nettonennleistung was never above Bruttoleistung or the inverter power.

Coordinates only for Nettonennleistung > 30 kW: 262,196 of 262,216 operating units above 30 kW have Breitengrad; units with Bruttoleistung > 30 but Nettonennleistung ≤ 30 have none. 96% of operating units (mostly rooftop and balcony) are located only by postcode/municipality.
3 of 1,000 sampled coordinates (>30 kW) fall outside their own Bundesland, e.g. SEE990564981245 'Nördlingen' (Bayern) at 52.88 N.
Operator: 'natürliche Person (ABR…)' replaces the name for natural-person operators – 86% of a 1,000-row page of all operating solar units, 47% of units >30 kW and 19.5% of Freiflächen units.

Self-consumption vs grid plants: 5,404,598 operating units are 'Teileinspeisung (einschließlich Eigenverbrauch)' (3,862,520 of them on buildings) and 1,112,487 'Volleinspeisung'; about 17,000 carry no value. Filter 'Volleinspeisung oder Teileinspeisung' to separate them.

Without the status filter the result includes 63,315 'In Planung', 8,417 'Vorübergehend stillgelegt' and 95,863 'Endgültig stillgelegt' solar units; without the type filter it includes 1,559,990 operating balcony units.

Grid-operator verification: of the operating solar units 4,378,535 are 'Geprüft', 595,483 still 'In Prüfung' and 1,559,990 (all balcony units) 'Nicht vorgesehen'; filter Netzbetreiberprüfung if only verified records are wanted.
The JSON endpoint is the undocumented backend of the viewer; its parameters may change without notice.
The page's CSV export holds only the first 25,000 rows of a selection; the 20,213 operating Freiflächen units fit, the 6.5 million operating units do not.
Operators have one month to register after commissioning, so the latest month is incomplete; the 'Aktuelle Einheitenübersicht' is real-time but has no coordinate columns.
The MaStR FAQ speaks of '30 kW(p)', but the data follow Nettonennleistung: filter on Nettonennleistung > 30 to select units with coordinates.

EinheitenSolar_68.xml (1,628 units): <EinheitSolar><EinheitMastrNummer>SEE926618310853</EinheitMastrNummer><LokationMaStRNummer>SEL926746158228</LokationMaStRNummer>…<Laengengrad>9.189542</Laengengrad><Breitengrad>49.229366</Breitengrad><Inbetriebnahmedatum>2026-11-26</Inbetriebnahmedatum><EinheitBetriebsstatus>35</EinheitBetriebsstatus><Bruttoleistung>202.920</Bruttoleistung><Nettonennleistung>160.000</Nettonennleistung><ArtDerSolaranlage>853</ArtDerSolaranlage>
steps: Download the 'Gesamtdatenauszug vom Vortag' (≈3.3 GB ZIP; file name carries date and export version, e.g. Gesamtdatenexport_20261127_26.2.zip) or a dated snapshot under /Stichtag/.
Read EinheitenSolar_1…68.xml as UTF-16 XML; one <EinheitSolar> element per unit.
Decode catalogue codes with Katalogwerte.xml (Id → Wert) and Katalogkategorien.xml.
Keep EinheitBetriebsstatus = 35 (In Betrieb) and, if wanted, ArtDerSolaranlage = 852 (Freiflächensolaranlage).
Join AnlagenbetreiberMastrNummer to Marktakteure_*.xml (MastrNummer) for Firmenname; Personenart 518 rows carry no name.
Group units into sites with LokationMaStRNummer (or Lokationen_*.xml VerknuepfteEinheitenMaStRNummern).
reading_traps: UTF-16 encoding and numeric catalogue codes everywhere (e.g. Bundesland 1409 = Nordrhein-Westfalen, Energietraeger 2495 = Solare Strahlungsenergie).
In EinheitenSolar_68.xml only 39 of 1,628 units carry Laengengrad/Breitengrad; the smallest net capacity with coordinates was 35 kW and the largest without was 30 kW.
The documentation's example values swap the axes (Laengengrad 51.254, Breitengrad 12.597); the data themselves are correct (e.g. Laengengrad 9.189542, Breitengrad 49.229366 in Bad Wimpfen).
Export versions change structure (new format since 01.10.2025) and are not backward compatible; check the documentation for the version in the file name.
Operator names are not in the unit file: a unit-only parse shows only ABR numbers.

problems: Full ZIP is 3.3 GB; tested by headers and Range reads of the central directory and of EinheitenSolar_68.xml, Katalogwerte.xml, Lokationen_71.xml and the start of EinheitenSolar_1.xml and Marktakteure_1.xml.

steps: Download the four ZIPs (50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT, TransnetBW) from the landing page; each holds one CSV.
Read with encoding cp1252 and delimiter ';'; convert decimal commas.
Keep Energietraeger = 9 (Solar); treat rows with empty Ausserbetriebnahme as connected to that grid operator at 31.12.2025 and check filled rows against Netzabgang and MaStR.
Decode Bundesland, Energietraeger and Einspeisespannungsebene with anlagenstammdaten_legende.xlsx.
Join EEG_Mastr_Nr to MaStR (EegMaStRNummer) to add coordinates and operator.
reading_traps: No plant operator and no coordinates: NB_Mastr_Nr/UENB_Mastr_Nr are grid operators.
Counting unit is the EEG installation, not the MaStR unit; installations that changed grid operator during the year can appear twice (stated on the landing page).
Strasse_Flurstueck is empty for every TransnetBW solar row up to 30 kW (smallest with street: 30.01 kW).
The CSV exceeds spreadsheet row limits (TransnetBW alone has 714,835 rows); the landing page warns that Excel silently drops excess lines.
A year-end snapshot: plants commissioned in 2026 are missing.

installierte_Leistung usually equals MaStR EegInstallierteLeistung (EEG953217273524: 48401,86 in both) but not always: EEG966734369304 shows 74800, which is the MaStR Nettonennleistung (Bruttoleistung 80308.8 kW), and its Ort 'Mengen' differs from the MaStR Gemeinde 'Langenenslingen'.

Ausserbetriebnahme is also filled when an installation leaves the grid operator: EEG970935572432 has Ausserbetriebnahme and Netzabgang 15.01.2025 but is 'In Betrieb' in MaStR; dropping filled Ausserbetriebnahme rows removes some operating installations.

problems: The file server answers HEAD requests with 405 Method Not Allowed; GET works.
Range requests are ignored (full file returned).

steps: Download the GeoJSON (154 MB) or request the Excel file through GEM's 'Download data' section.
Filter country-area1 = 'Germany' and status = 'operating'.
Use location-accuracy to separate exact from approximate points.
Compare with MaStR via name/municipality; no MaStR IDs are carried in the map file fields seen.
reading_traps: Status mixes operating and prospective phases in one file.
Capacity is MWac; MaStR Bruttoleistung is module kWp (DC), so GEM values are usually lower than MaStR gross.
start-year is a year, not a date, and may be empty.

publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Operators register every unit with location, capacity, commissioning date and operator; the Bundesnetzagentur publishes the register except location details of units ≤30 kW and data of natural-person operators.
publication_obligation.frequency: Registration within one month of commissioning; real-time web overview, previous-day extended overview and daily XML export.

consolidated_republication.note: The Bundesnetzagentur republishes all operator registrations in MaStR (web overviews, JSON behind the viewer, daily XML export). The four TSOs additionally republish DSO-reported EEG master data once a year on netztransparenz.de.

national_registry.note: The Marktstammdatenregister is the official national register; every PV unit must be registered regardless of size or age, and its public part is open (DL-DE-BY-2.0).

if_unstructured.summary: No document route is needed for the published attributes: MaStR is structured. The two gaps – exact location of units ≤30 kW and names of natural-person operators – are withheld under § 15 MaStRV; no official document source publishing them was found, and the TSO EEG files apply the same 30 kW address cut.
if_unstructured.location_method: Units ≤30 kW carry only Postleitzahl, Ort, Gemeinde and Gemeindeschluessel: usable for municipal or postcode maps, not for distances.

open_questions: The MaStR FAQ withholds exact location for plants 'kleiner oder gleich 30 kW(p)', but in the published data the cut follows Nettonennleistung (units with Bruttoleistung >30 kWp and Nettonennleistung ≤30 kW have no coordinates); only the Bundesnetzagentur can say which value governs.

The TransnetBW EEG file gives installierte_Leistung 74800 and Ort 'Mengen' for EEG966734369304, while MaStR shows Bruttoleistung 80308.8 kW, Nettonennleistung 74800 kW and Gemeinde 'Langenenslingen'; the TSO would have to explain the basis used.
